title: Talada Xigmad ku Jirta
intro: Bal qiyaas adigoo ag taagan qof aan loo aqoon mucjisooyin ama boqortooyooyin, laakiin hadallo weli hagaya quluubta maanta. Addoonkan Alle wuxuu helay hadiyad qaali ah wuxuuna ku shubay mahadnaq talo kasta oo la siiyo arday dhallinyaro ah oo la jecel yahay.
clues: Alle wuxuu igu nimceeyay xigmad, waxaana la i faray inaan ku mahadceliyo.
Waxaan wiilkayga kula hadlay waano naxariis leh, digniin jacayl iyo walaac leh.
Waxaan wiilkayga u sheegay in la wadaajinta Alle ay tahay qalad aad u weyn.
Waxaan wiilkayga kula taliyay inuu tukado, wanaagga farayo, xumaanta ka reebo, oo dulqaado.
Waxaan wiilkayga uga digay inaanu kibir dhabanka ka leexin ama aanu dhulka ku socon kibir.
Waxaan wiilkayga baray inuu dhexdhexaad noqdo oo uu hoos u dhigo codka, waayo codadka ugu adag waa qaylada dameeraha.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
